reason: DISPROVEN as a data artifact; the FAIL is a genuine ORG-CONFIG-DEFECT and I agree with the executor. All three required proofs hold on fresh live re-measurement. (1) Inputs valid and match test_setup: existing (non-headless) USD quote, active pricebook, active IsDerived USD PBE; the headless-$0 hydration trap does not apply to an existing record and the rest of the quote prices fine (RSS-EFES List=958.8), so the null is isolated to this derived line. (2) Intended branch fired: line IsDerived=true, Fortra_Product_Type__c=New Maintenance routes through the native DerivedProducts element / Derived Pricing Filter; quote CalculationStatus=CompletedWithPricing, reprice isSuccess=true. (3) V21 still wrong: fresh Force-reprice on the CURRENT active V21 yields NetUnitPrice=null with every price stamp null/0 and NO error surfaced. Causality proven: PBEDP is a necessary config gate -- every derived PBE in the org that prices non-null carries exactly 1 PBEDP row (PIA-PIA-RNM-PIAMBK nets 0.20x355=71), the covered sibling EFT8 maps contributor GS-GSE-NRPS-E8CP via Formula=UnitPrice, and the disputed PBE has 0 PBEDP rows, so the native element has no contributing product to pull list from and emits a silent null instead of the expected 'contributing products missing' hard-error. This is the incomplete SC-3372 / M5-PBEDP backfill (199/1889 covered): missing org-level product config, not a fixture defect -- a real UI rep adding GS-GSE-RNM-EF8 hits the identical gap (uiUserWouldHit=yes). Classified ORG-CONFIG-DEFECT (not PROCEDURE-DEFECT: the native element behaves as designed on a missing-PBEDP input; not TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT: inputs valid and existing; not EXPECTATION-ERROR: silent null masking the gap from the rep is genuinely wrong vs the expected hard-error).
